body.zh-Hant: 巴特列生於1856年5月21日，是新聞工作者。他最初的興趣是哲學而非政治，年少時受卡爾·克里斯蒂安·弗里德里希·克勞澤（Karl Christian Friedrich Kraus）的思想影響，並開始終身的新聞生涯，為《La Razón》《La Lucha》《El Espíritu Nuevo》等刊物撰稿。他在1876至1886年間對抗拉托雷與桑托斯的軍事獨裁，參與1886年反桑托斯的克夫拉喬革命，同年創辦報紙《El Día》。
body.en: Batlle y Ordóñez was born on 21 May 1856 and was a journalist. His first interest was philosophy rather than politics; as a youth he was influenced by the ideas of Karl Christian Friedrich Kraus, and he began a lifelong journalism career, writing for periodicals such as La Razón, La Lucha and El Espíritu Nuevo. Between 1876 and 1886 he confronted the military dictatorships of Lorenzo Latorre and Máximo Santos, took part in the 1886 Quebracho Revolution against Santos, and in the same year founded the newspaper El Día.

heading.zh-Hant: 第一任總統與歐洲之行
heading.en: First presidency and the European journey

body.zh-Hant: 1903年3月1日，大會（General Assembly）選巴特列為總統。他的第一任期遇上1903與1904年由卡迪略阿帕里西奧·薩拉維亞（Aparicio Saravia）領導的布蘭科黨起事。任內推動的改革包括廢除死刑、合法化協議離婚等。1907年任滿後他隨即啟程，展開近四年的歐洲與近東之行，並於1907年出席第二屆海牙國際和平會議。他在1911年2月返回烏拉圭，3月1日再度當選總統。
body.en: On 1 March 1903 the General Assembly elected Batlle president. His first term was marked by the Blanco uprisings of 1903 and 1904 led by the caudillo Aparicio Saravia. Reforms in this period included the abolition of the death penalty and the legalization of divorce by mutual consent. After his term ended in 1907 he left almost at once on a trip to Europe and the Near East that lasted almost four years, and in 1907 he took part in the Second International Peace Conference in The Hague. He returned to Uruguay in February 1911 and on 1 March was again elected president.

heading.zh-Hant: 第二任期、集體行政制與晚年
heading.en: Second presidency, the collegiate executive and final years

body.zh-Hant: 巴特列的第二任期是他的改革方案付諸實行的決定性時期。1916年7月30日制憲會議選舉中，巴特列派失利。繼任總統費利西亞諾·比埃拉（Feliciano Viera）採行所謂的「暫停」政策；政治民主化則隨1919年的第二部憲法到來。烏拉圭總統府名單載明，他曾於1921至1923年擔任國家行政委員會（Consejo Nacional de Administración）主席。他在1929年10月20日去世，距華爾街股災只差幾天。
body.en: Batlle y Ordóñez's second presidency was the decisive period in which his reform plan was implemented. Batllism suffered a defeat in the decisive elections of 30 July 1916 for the National Constituent Assembly, and his successor Feliciano Viera adopted the so-called "halt politics"; the democratization of the political system came with the second constitution in 1919. The Uruguayan presidency's list records José Batlle y Ordóñez as president of the National Council of Administration for 1921-1923. He died on 20 October 1929, a few days before the Wall Street crash.

people.nameZh: 何塞·帕特里西奧·古賈里

body.zh-Hant: 古賈里1884年3月17日生，是義大利移民之子，生於亞松森，年幼時遷到內陸小鎮比亞里卡（Villarrica），在那裡受早期教育。他後來回到巴拉圭攻讀法律，1910年在國立大學（National University）取得法學博士學位。
body.en: Guggiari was born on 17 March 1884, the son of Italian immigrants, in Asunción, but as a young child moved to the interior town of Villarrica, where he received his early education. He returned to Paraguay to pursue legal studies and received a doctorate in law from the National University in 1910.

moved to the interior town of Villarrica, where he received his early education
received a doctorate in law from the National University in 1910

heading.en: The Liberal Party and the legislature

body.zh-Hant: 古賈里最晚在1903年已加入自由黨。當時自由黨分成多個爭吵的派系，他努力調和各派，雖只部分成功，仍贏得沉穩而有效率的民主派名聲。他在黨內與立法部門都升到最高層，1912年當選眾議員，1918年被選為眾議院議長。兩年後總統曼努埃爾·貢德拉選他出任內政部長。
body.en: Guggiari affiliated with the Liberal Party as early as 1903. The Liberals were then divided into bickering factions, and he worked hard to reconcile them; though only partly successful, he gained a reputation as a level-headed and efficient democrat. He rose to the highest ranks within the party and the legislative branch, was elected deputy in 1912, and in 1918 was chosen president of the Chamber of Deputies. Two years later President Manuel Gondra chose him to become interior minister.

body.zh-Hant: 1928年總統選舉中，古賈里擊敗愛德華多·弗萊塔斯（Eduardo Fleitas），被廣泛視為當時最誠實的一次選舉。他任內致力於鞏固民主制度，但與玻利維亞的大廈科（Gran Chaco）爭端日益惡化，使這些努力黯然失色，也間接導致他下台。1931年10月23日，學生在國宮前集會抗議政府對玻利維亞入侵的謹慎回應，警察開火，打死八人、打傷三十人。古賈里兩天後辭去總統職務，長期流亡，在布宜諾斯艾利斯去世。
body.en: In the 1928 presidential election Guggiari defeated Eduardo Fleitas, a vote widely regarded as the most honest up to that time. As president he dedicated himself to consolidating Paraguay's democratic institutions, but these efforts were eclipsed by the worsening dispute with Bolivia over the Gran Chaco, which indirectly brought about his downfall. On 23 October 1931 students protested the government's cautious response to Bolivian incursions in front of the National Palace; the police fired on the gathering, killing eight and wounding thirty. Guggiari resigned two days later, spent a long exile, and died in Buenos Aires.

body.zh-Hant: 塞拉托1868年9月30日生。他在烏拉圭共和國大學（Universidad Mayor de la República）1888年取得測量師（agrimensor）資格，1892年取得土木工程師（道路橋樑方向）學位，是首批本國工程師之一。總統府名單稱他為測量師與土木工程師。法國國家圖書館權威檔把他描述為經濟學者。
body.en: Serrato was born on 30 September 1868. At the Universidad Mayor de la República he qualified as a land surveyor (agrimensor) in 1888 and as a civil engineer (roads and bridges) in 1892, one of the first group of national engineers. The presidency's list calls him a surveyor and civil engineer. The authority record of the Bibliothèque nationale de France describes him as an economist.

heading.zh-Hant: 科洛拉多黨與早期部長任職
heading.en: Colorado Party and early ministerial posts

body.zh-Hant: 1897年塞拉托任科洛拉多黨全國執行委員會秘書。他在1899至1902年為蒙特維多選出的眾議員；1903年他推動巴特列（José Batlle y Ordóñez）的候選資格。1903至1904年他任公共工程部（Fomento）部長，1904至1906年任財政部長，起初是代理部長，後來轉為正式部長。
body.en: In 1897 Serrato was secretary of the National Executive Committee of the Colorado Party. He was a deputy for Montevideo from 1899 to 1902, and in 1903 he promoted the candidacy of José Batlle y Ordóñez. From 1903 to 1904 he was minister of Fomento (public works), and from 1904 to 1906 minister of finance, starting as acting minister and then continuing as full minister.

heading.zh-Hant: 參議員、財政部長與脫離巴特列派
heading.en: Senator, finance minister and break with Batlle

body.zh-Hant: 塞拉托在1908至1911年為塔夸倫博選出的科洛拉多黨參議員。1911至1913年他再任財政部長，後來辭職；1912年曾代理內政部長。1913年他出任首個反集體行政制委員會（Comité Anticolegialista）主席，這個立場使他與巴特列及巴特列主義分道揚鑣。
body.en: From 1908 to 1911 Serrato was a Colorado senator for Tacuarembó. From 1911 to 1913 he was again minister of finance, a post he left by resignation, and in 1912 he was acting minister of the interior. In 1913 he became president of the first Anti-Collegialist Committee, a position that led him to break with Batlle and Batllism.

body.zh-Hant: 1913至1922年塞拉托任抵押銀行（BHU）總裁，被稱為該銀行的創辦人與組織章程作者。1921年他推動「塞拉托法」，向公務員、退休者與領撫恤者提供購置自宅的特別貸款。1923至1927年他任總統，是首位直選產生的總統；其間依1919年憲法與國家行政委員會共享行政權。任內啟用國會大廈、通過農村最低工資法，並設立選舉法院。
body.en: From 1913 to 1922 Serrato was president of the Banco Hipotecario del Uruguay (BHU), described as the bank's creator and author of its charter. In 1921 he promoted the "Serrato Law", which gave special credit to public employees, retirees and pensioners for buying their own homes. He was president from 1923 to 1927 and the first president elected directly; under the 1919 constitution he shared executive power with a National Council of Administration. During his presidency the Legislative Palace was inaugurated, the rural minimum-wage law passed and an Electoral Court created.

heading.zh-Hant: 銀行總裁、國務委員與外交部長
heading.en: Bank president, Council of State and foreign minister

body.zh-Hant: 1933至1934年塞拉托任共和國東岸銀行（BROU）總裁，後來辭去該職。1942年他是國務委員會（Consejo de Estado）委員，總統府名單說該委員會由巴爾多米爾（Baldomir）於1942年設立。1943至1945年他任外交部長，1945年率烏拉圭代表團出席舊金山會議。他於1960年9月7日在蒙特維多去世。
body.en: From 1933 to 1934 Serrato was president of the Banco de la República Oriental del Uruguay (BROU), a post he resigned. In 1942 he was a councillor of the Council of State, which the presidency's list says was set up by Baldomir in 1942. From 1943 to 1945 he was foreign minister, and in 1945 he headed the Uruguayan delegation to the San Francisco Conference. He died in Montevideo on 7 September 1960.
